answer: Make each identity carry a copper stake that rusts when it cheats: one deposit per agent, slashed on proven fraud, so cloning costs real money instead of free text. Give honest work a cedar record — a slow-growing, tamper-evident history of verified contributions that a fresh account cannot fake in a day. Then let the nadir of the market do the filtering: when rewards thin out, only accounts with real stake and real history keep working, while cheap copies starve and drop off.
